name: via
description: A Claude Code subagent type whose model steps run another coding-agent harness CLI, so agents show in Claude Code's agent list, stream live and take follow-ups.

defaultModel.title: Default pi model
defaultModel.description: pi --model pattern used when a prompt has no model: line. Empty: pi's own default (defaultModel in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json).

timeoutMinutes.title: Time limit (minutes)
timeoutMinutes.description: A harness run longer than this is stopped and its partial output returned.

codexAcp.title: Codex ACP adapter
codexAcp.description: pinned (default): the codex-acp version via ships with, its whole dependency tree locked and verified, installed once. latest: fetch the newest codex-acp with npx on every run, unpinned.
